head: 6f49ae3a717e5521051704c7055016a3ae0ccefd
summary:
SL-075 adds four plant rows, F20-F23, to eng/rules-harness/plants.json and two decoy-engine checks to RuleCases C-006. I re-measured it independently. harness.py was run with --engine-root set to the taad_v3 checkout (faecfc3, clean) and --scenario all, on this tree's own .dotnet (SDK 10.0.401), with no --dotnet-from. It gave 52 rows, 52 AS-RECORDED, 0 stray hits, exit 0, in 17 s. The clean baseline was 11 Facts and 64 rules with 0 hits. git status was the same before and after. F20-F23 each came out fire/fire. F01-F19, P07c-e, S01-S13 and D1-D13 all kept their recorded outcomes, and divergences.json is not in the slice diff.

To check that the rows are not trivially AS-RECORDED, I ran four mutated copies through --plants (a temp file outside the tree). Each was caught:
- F20 without also_settled gave STRAY-HIT.
- F21 relabelled '(App)' gave MISSED-BY-FITNESS plus STRAY-HIT naming '(Core)', so the rule string does tell the two same-named entries apart.
- F22 recorded as fitness quiet gave FIRED-WHEN-EXEMPT.
- F23 missing SL-044's settled rule gave STRAY-HIT naming it.
That run exited 1.

The other checks:
- rules-parity: AGREE 11 facts, 15 twinned entries, 27 patterns; exit 0.
- RuleCases -Case All: C-001 to C-014 held, exit 0, 299 s, git status unchanged.
- RuleCases -Case C-006 on its own: all 8 decoy lines passed. With a decoy on PYTHONPATH the header still names the engine root's fitness.py. A decoy preloaded by sitecustomize gives exit 2, 'not from this root', and its check() is never called.
- A --dotnet-from that points at a missing tree gives exit 2 CANNOT MEASURE.
- The Fitness tool: all 64 rules hold.
- Each of the four anchors matches exactly one line: EntryClassifier.cs:22, Scanner.cs:138, MainWindow.xaml.cs:523, VolumeSpace.cs:52.
- RuleCases.ps1 has no literal that counts plants.json rows. C-008's $MustFire is SL-022's fixed F01-F16.

Contact is 'code', not 'real'. All of this is the project's own test harness building a scratch copy and running xUnit plus a local engine checkout. No device or live environment is involved, and for a slice that is only test data there is none to reach. The slice ran one build attempt with no loop.

Housekeeping: %TEMP% holds about 140 fsa-parity-case-*, 6 fsa-engine-case-*, fsa-rules-case-7e13b29126 and fsa-rules-s1fjipsa, all created 20:16-20:18 local time. That is before this session's tool host started at 20:18:35, and it looks like a RuleCases run cut off around C-006/C-007. These folders are not from my runs and I left them in place. My own RuleCases and harness runs cleaned up after themselves, and I deleted the two scratch folders that my exit-1 and exit-2 runs kept.

checks.what: Mutation of the new rows: F20 without also_settled, F21 relabelled (App), F22 recorded fitness quiet, F23 missing SL-044's settled rule; checks the rows are discriminating and the rule string distinguishes the two NothingWaitsOnTheVolumeFigure entries
checks.evidence: M20 STRAY-HIT (fitness also fired 'the classifier does not list link tags; the surrogate bit is the rule'); M21 MISSED-BY-FITNESS STRAY-HIT (did not fire (App), also fired (Core)); M22 FIRED-WHEN-EXEMPT; M23 STRAY-HIT ('Core does not publish a live ScanStore before the scan ends'); '4 rows, 0 AS-RECORDED, 4 not'; exit 1; clean baseline CLEAN; git status unchanged. 'not from this root', 'harness: exit 2'; the decoy's check() is never called. All checks held, exit 0

criteria.criterion: 1. TheClassifierListsNoLinkTags fires on a hard-coded link tag (IO_REPARSE_TAG_SYMLINK const planted in EntryClassifier.cs, which also holds P07d/D3 plants)
criteria.how: The --scenario all run gave F20 xunit fire/fire and fitness fire/fire, AS-RECORDED, while P07d stayed quiet/quiet and D3 AS-RECORDED in the same run. Mutant M20 (no also_settled) gives STRAY-HIT on the settled twin, so the hit really comes from the plant.

criteria.criterion: 2. NothingWaitsOnTheVolumeFigure (Core) fires on `_store.VolumeUsedSource.Task.Wait();` in a Core file; App entry silent
criteria.how: F21 is fire/fire AS-RECORDED. judge() rejects any extra Fitness rule, so the App entry did not fire. Mutant M21, relabelled (App), gives 'did not fire (App)' and 'also fired (Core)'.

criteria.criterion: 3. NothingWaitsOnTheVolumeFigure (App) fires on a blocking wait in the App project; Core entry silent; the xUnit Fact fails
criteria.how: F22 is xunit fire/fire (the one Fact) and fitness fire/fire, AS-RECORDED, with 0 stray hits. Mutant M22, recorded fitness quiet, gives FIRED-WHEN-EXEMPT naming '(App)'.

criteria.criterion: 4. The two same-named entries are told apart by the row's rule string
criteria.how: F21 and F22 ran in one batch and each came out AS-RECORDED. M21 shows that swapping the glob suffix makes the row fail: MISSED-BY-FITNESS plus STRAY-HIT.

criteria.criterion: 5. TheVolumeReadHoldsNoScanStore fires on a ScanStore reference in VolumeSpace.cs; SL-044's settled rule also fires
criteria.how: F23 is fire/fire AS-RECORDED with both also_settled entries. Mutant M23, missing 'Core does not publish a live ScanStore before the scan ends', gives STRAY-HIT naming that rule, so it does fire.

criteria.criterion: 6. Clean baseline stays quiet on the edited tree
criteria.how: The clean phase of both my harness runs showed xunit 11 Facts with 0 hits and fitness 64 rules, 117 files, 0 hits, none unmatched, CLEAN. The one NOT RUN is the import rule, which needs a code graph the scratch copy lacks.

criteria.criterion: 7. Committed rows reproduce the spike's outcomes and the 48 old rows do not move (39 rows, --scenario all, divergences.json unchanged)
criteria.how: The independent --scenario all run gave 52 rows, 52 AS-RECORDED, 0 stray hits, exit 0. divergences.json is absent from git diff f8b98c4..HEAD.

criteria.criterion: 8. Outcome comes from the TAAD engine at --engine-root, even with taad3.fitness importable elsewhere
criteria.how: Every run's header names C:\Users\sshub\projets\taad_v3\backend\taad3\fitness.py. In C-006, a PYTHONPATH decoy still gives CLEAN from the engine root, and a sitecustomize-preloaded decoy gives exit 2 'not from this root'. I ran both myself.

criteria.criterion: 9. RuleCases.ps1 agrees with the new row counts (no stale 35/19/F19 literal)
criteria.how: The grep finds no row-count literal; C-008's 1..16 is SL-022's fixed set. RuleCases -Case All holds C-001 to C-014, exit 0.
eng/rules-parity.ps1 gives AGREE 11 facts <- 15 twinned entries, 27 patterns; exit 0. Only plants.json and RuleCases.ps1 changed outside the slice folder.

criteria.criterion: 11. A row that omits a settled twin fails
criteria.how: The design marks this material false, but I checked it directly. M20 and M23, run through the real harness without their also_settled keys, both give STRAY-HIT, exit 1.

criteria.criterion: 12. Evidence written into the tree before the run (untracked non-ignored .cs under .taad/slices/SL-075 copied to scratch)
criteria.how: The slice folder holds only .json and .txt, with no .cs. My run copied the untracked evidence files into the scratch tree and the baseline stayed CLEAN with 52/52 AS-RECORDED. I did not plant a .cs to see what one would do; the design marks it material false.

criteria.criterion: 13. No .NET 10 SDK on this PC (--dotnet-from missing tree, no network)
criteria.how: --dotnet-from C:\nonexistent-sl075-tree gives 'CANNOT MEASURE: ... has no eng/dotnet.ps1', exit 2, and records no outcome. The failure comes before any download, so network state does not affect it. The no-network download branch of eng/dotnet.ps1 itself was not exercised.

obligations.evidence: The committed plants.json (39 rows, including F20-F23), not a scratch file, was run under --scenario all with --engine-root taad_v3\backend at faecfc3 on this tree's own .dotnet. It gave 52 rows, 52 AS-RECORDED, 0 not, 0 stray hits, exit 0. F01-F19, P07c-e, S01-S13 and D1-D13 all kept their recorded outcomes, and divergences.json is not in the slice diff. The mutated copies of F20-F23 each fail, so those AS-RECORDED results do discriminate.

This tree's gitignored .dotnet holds SDK 10.0.401 (.dotnet\dotnet.exe --list-sdks). The harness built its scratch copy in 6 s with C:\Users\sshub\projets\filesystem-analyser-v2-wt\SL-075\eng\dotnet.ps1, with no --dotnet-from and no borrowed SL-074 SDK. It was downloaded earlier through eng/dotnet.ps1, which Q-003 allows. The machine-wide SDKs are still only 8 and 9.

not_reached: No real device or live environment. The deliverable is test data for the rules harness, so the strongest contact available is the harness's own scratch-copy dotnet build, the xUnit run and a local engine checkout. That is contact 'code'.

The engine measured is the taad_v3 checkout's backend at faecfc3, not a packaged or installed TAAD engine, because none exists on this PC. A different engine revision could record different outcomes for F20-F23.

Fitness never reaches verdict 'pass' on the scratch copy. The import rule 'the provider does not use the code it checks' is NOT RUN because the scratch has no code graph, so F20-F23 are measured only on the must_not_match half and the xUnit twins.
The no-network branch of eng/dotnet.ps1 was not exercised: this tree already has SDK 10.0.401 in .dotnet, and simulating a network loss would mean touching network settings.

No .cs file was planted under .taad/slices/SL-075 to see whether a Fitness *.cs glob would pick it up and disturb the baseline. The design marks criterion 12 as material false, and no such file exists.

F17-F23 are covered only by plain harness plants/all runs. No RuleCases case asserts them (C-008 is fixed at F01-F16), so a future edit to RuleCases would not notice these rows going stale. build-slice already raised this as open.
